page.layout: One table of calendar columns, with a header line above it. Columns: year of Julian period, dominical letters, Nabonassar era, weekday (feriae), and a column of Julian-date notes between weekday and Christian year. Running head ANNORVM. at top centre, page number 413 at top right.

main_text.l: Amni Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabonasari. | Feriæ. | | Christi.

page.notes: The first header word is printed as "Amni"; it may be "Anni" in the original. The Julian-date notes (—15 Iul. etc.) sit in an unlabelled column between the weekday and Christian year and are copied as an empty cell where no note stands. Lines 199–230 are transcribed row by row, with the printed numbers as seen. The page number reads "41³" in the scan, taken as 413.
